name: Prism Mage
lore: A human prism mage who guards Moonveil’s mirrors from the jealous Marquis.

primary.name: Prism Lance
primary.description: Fire a 20-damage lance. After 150 units it splits into two diverging 13-damage bolts.

secondary.name: Prism Unfurl
secondary.description: Three glass shards spiral outward from your casting spot for 2 seconds, reaching 250 units. Each shard can hit each enemy once for 14 damage; walls stop shards.

special.name: Moonlit Procession
special.description: Five moonlight blooms advance along your aim, each dealing 22 damage and slowing enemies for 2 seconds.

passive: Far Refraction: outward spirals reach 60 units farther.

technique.name: Distant Procession
technique.description: Moonlight blooms are spaced 40% farther apart, with 20% smaller radii.

final_technique.name: Prismatic Handshake
final_technique.description: Link up to three visible enemies with delayed prism strikes for 15 each. Multi-target reach replaces the split lance; slower, and needs nearby targets.

attack.name: Prismatic Handshake
attack.description: Link up to three visible enemies with delayed prism strikes for 15 each. Multi-target reach replaces the split lance; slower, and needs nearby targets.
